tasks.name: Freeze domain and API contracts
tasks.instructions: Document lifecycle states, invariants, ownership boundaries, idempotency rules, offline conflict policy, and the canonical error envelope before implementation.

tasks.name: Add contract characterization tests
tasks.instructions: Add tests that capture the current critical count, finalization, sync, and error behaviors so later changes expose regressions.

tasks.name: Replace destructive count edits
tasks.instructions: Implement void/supersede semantics, preserve immutable history, capture actor/reason/timestamp, and update API/UI behavior.

tasks.name: Gate repair operations
tasks.instructions: Require explicit authorization, reason, audit event, and safe default dry-run for repair tooling.

tasks.name: Centralize finalization readiness
tasks.instructions: Create a single readiness policy shared by API and UI, including unresolved conflicts, pending sync, evidence, and variance requirements.

tasks.name: Make offline writes idempotent
tasks.instructions: Add stable operation IDs, replay protection, explicit conflict states, and retry-safe client behavior.

tasks.name: Implement hierarchical locations
tasks.instructions: Add stable location identity and ancestry/path semantics while retaining compatibility with existing location references.

tasks.name: Prepare and rehearse location migration
tasks.instructions: Create reversible migration and backfill scripts, run them in dry-run against a snapshot, and record row counts and rollback evidence.

tasks.name: Introduce canonical inventory identity
tasks.instructions: Define canonical item identity, aliases, normalized codes, uniqueness rules, and deterministic duplicate resolution.

tasks.name: Backfill and verify identity links
tasks.instructions: Run an idempotent dry-run backfill, review collisions, then execute only with a backup and rollback path.

tasks.name: Model physical batches
tasks.instructions: Implement batch identity, quantities, lifecycle transitions, concurrency control, and links to items and locations.

tasks.name: Implement serial registry
tasks.instructions: Add normalized unique serials, lifecycle/location history, duplicate handling, imports, scans, and audit events.

tasks.name: Implement damage cases and evidence
tasks.instructions: Create damage lifecycle, severity/reason taxonomy, append-only evidence metadata, authorization, and secure storage links.

tasks.name: Build reconciliation projections
tasks.instructions: Create explainable variance projections, exception queues, assignment/state transitions, filters, and drill-down evidence.

tasks.name: Unify backend and client errors
tasks.instructions: Adopt the documented error envelope, stable error codes, correlation IDs, safe messages, client parsing, and compatibility handling.

tasks.name: Prioritize advanced capabilities
tasks.instructions: Choose advanced analytics, automation, and AI features only after measuring the stable domain model; document value, risk, privacy, fallback, and monitoring.

tasks.name: Implement approved advanced slice
tasks.instructions: Deliver the approved smallest vertical slice behind a feature flag with evaluation, observability, and rollback.
